description: Docs gap: PATCH /workers/scripts/{script_name}/settings requires multipart/form-data with the settings JSON as a `settings` form part (the docs model it as a plain JSON PATCH with no body member, and the live API rejects that with ContentTypeRequired). Transcribed from the distilled SDK's patchScriptScriptAndVersionSetting; the settings object is opaque (Document) with the service key dictionary handling wire naming.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: Worker settings to patch (bindings, tags, tail consumers, ...), JSON-encoded as the multipart `settings` part.
